item.title: Canada’s Cassie Sharpe suffers crash in qualifying, removed on sled
item.description: A scary scene unfolded on Thursday in Livigno. Canadian Cassie Sharpe was removed from the ski halfpipe qualifier on a sled after taking a hard fall during her second run at Milano Cortina 2026. Sharpe waved to the crowd she was removed from the hill. She scored 88.25 points to sit third after the qualifying […]

item.title: B.C. paramedics union could strike, could reach deal after vote; negotiations ongoing
item.description: The union representing B.C.’s ambulance paramedics and emergency dispatchers will not strike Thursday, but says it's poised to do so after members overwhelmingly voted in favour of job action this month.

item.title: Grouse Grind re-closes after winter weather on North Shore
item.description: After opening unseasonably early this month, the North Shore's Grouse Grind has closed again.

item.title: Canada’s Team Jacobs advances to curling gold medal final after beating Norway 5-4
item.description: Canada’s Team Brad Jacobs will have a chance to end the country’s Olympic curling drought. Jacobs edged Team Magnus Ramsfjell of Norway 5-4 in an extra end on Thursday at Milano Cortina 2026, sending Canada to the men’s gold-medal game. Jacobs will face reigning world champion Team Bruce Mouat of Great Britain in the gold-medal […]

item.title: Amid extortion crisis, Surrey police has proposed budget increase slashed
item.description: The City of Surrey says on Thursday that it has greenlit a $284.5 million budget for the Surrey Police Service (SPS), an increased allowance of $45 million compared to last year’s budget.
